description: A capitalized name binds an ordinary value when no enum in scope has a variant of that name, in let, fn parameters, and loop bindings, and uses resolve to the value.
program:
(def N 3)
(defn scaled [X] (* X N))
(let [P (* N 2) [A B] [P 1] doubled (map (fn [Y] (* Y 2)) [A B])] (loop {:max 5} [I 0 Total 0] (if (< I N) (recur (+ I 1) (+ Total (scaled I))) [Total doubled (= N 3)])))
